field_contract.requirement_id: stable unique ID; never reused for a different semantic requirement
field_contract.source_refs: one or more exact source paths/issues and section identifiers
field_contract.source_text: verbatim or minimally normalized controlling statement
field_contract.overall_status: derived; PASS only if all applicable required dimensions PASS or justified N/A
field_contract.dimensions: map of evidence dimension to dimension record
field_contract.rationale: why status was assigned; no unsupported assertions
field_contract.repair_target: required when overall_status is not PASS
field_contract.audited_commit: exact commit SHA used for evidence

field_contract.evidence: array of exact repo paths plus symbols/test names/line anchors where practical
field_contract.rationale: specific reason for status; N/A requires explicit explanation

closure_policy.issue_can_close_when: all mandatory requirements mapped to that issue are PASS
closure_policy.module_can_be_GO_when: all mandatory requirements for that module are PASS

anti_inference_rules: Do not infer an unimplemented named object from a generic JSONB ledger.
Do not infer a named service from a monolithic service unless all required semantics and tests are mapped.
Do not infer state-machine completeness from enums or documentation alone.
Do not infer dashboard conformance from a summary API endpoint.
Do not infer fixture coverage from tests that construct data inline unless a committed fixture is explicitly required.
Do not infer replay conformance from ordinary unit tests.
Do not infer provenance from human-readable rationale strings when source/evidence identity is required.
Do not infer decay/expiry behavior from timestamp fields without enforcement and tests.
Do not infer issue completion from a merged PR or green CI.
Do not convert missing evidence to N/A without requirement-specific rationale.
